modules.name: GridDrums
modules.description: Six-track, sixteen-step trigger sequencer played from a monome grid (via serialosc) or the on-screen grid, with 16 pattern slots that change at the next bar

modules.name: LessConcepts
modules.description: Cellular-automaton melody sequencer for two voices, after the norns script less concepts by dan derks and linus schrab: monome grid control, 16 snapshots with cycling, CV and gate outputs

modules.name: GridKeys
modules.description: Push-style note keyboard on a monome grid: notes from the bottom-left, the same note in several places, In Key or Chromatic, 26 scales, chord keys, strum, latch, poly and mono outputs
